source.note: Derived: the weapon has no charge of its own; the Quantum time to empty counts from the first shot

catalyst.name: Killing Wind, Envious Assassin, The Last Word Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Upon readying the weapon after scoring kills with your other Weapons:
Refills and/or overfills the Magazine from reserves based on the amount of Weapon Kills scored.
Loads 1 Ammo per kill achieved with other weapons.
Maximum total overfill amount is 200% of the Magazine Capacity. Each activation can only load up to 100% of the Magazine Capacity into the magazine.
On Weapon Kill, for 5 seconds:
• 50 Mobility
• 40 Handling and 20 Range
• 5% increased Damage Falloff Distance
Additional Kills extend the duration by 5 seconds, up to 8 seconds. Buff is removed on stow.
